recording_method: Transcription of the completed independent in-memory audit. No fixture scan was repeated to create this record; only the manifest and coverage receipt were reread and hashed.

fixture.capture_and_shard_fingerprints: Recorded in the fingerprinted fixture manifest; no current source-file hash is substituted for those historical fingerprints.

baseline_provenance.audit_program_note: The diagnostic programs ran from standard input and were not saved or fingerprinted. This record documents their observed results, not an independently rerunnable sealed execution.

independent_pixel_method.initial_objects: Eight-connected components of exact grey pixels across the entire band, without RAM positions or candidate search boxes.
independent_pixel_method.proposal_objects: One bounding envelope of all original grey pixels in this surface band. No filled or inferred pixels contribute to that envelope.

original_rectangle_diagnostic.ram_rule: r60 >= 2 and r118 < 160; rectangle (r118, 45, 8, 11), clipped to the general screen ROI.

two_fragment_example.interpretation: One clipped patrol actor is counted as two connected components.

occlusion_example.description: Two expected grey pixels at y52 are yellow player pixels; subtracting the existing RAM-side player support explains them without changing the patrol bounding box.

in_memory_development_proposal.ram_method: Use the observed surface support indexed by r24, clip x to [8,160), and subtract existing RAM-side player sprite points. The diagnostic used support164 as a fallback for other r24 values; no observed patrol result establishes that fallback for unseen animations.
in_memory_development_proposal.pixel_method: The independent surface-band envelope described above.
in_memory_development_proposal.residual_description: Four supports start one pixel lower and remain cut at y53. All occur with player r105=23, but no additional causal or RAM rule was inferred from that coincidence.

limits: This is a diagnostic and fitted proposal on the already opened development collection 17361; it is not reserved validation or the subsequently running V4 calibration.
No calibration threshold changed, no frame was excluded, and no prior receipt or source was edited by this audit.
The original 5367 RAM-indicated instance-frames include 579 invisible frames. They must not be described as 5367 pixel-visible patrol observations.
Instance-frame counts do not establish independent actor lifetimes or coverage of every game state, orientation, animation or occlusion.
The pixel comparison is independent of RAM boxes; the proposed RAM-side occlusion calculation reuses the existing empirical player support.
The four one-pixel residuals remain explicit; no post hoc special-case rule was added to eliminate them.
